Prospective Clinical Study

Abstract

This prospective clinical study evaluated treatment outcomes in adult patients.

Methods

A total of 120 patients were enrolled in the study.

After enrollment, 12 patients were excluded because they did not meet the final eligibility criteria.

An additional 10 patients were lost to follow-up.

Results

A total of 98 patients were included in the final analysis.

Treatment outcomes were evaluated in all 98 patients who completed the study.

Data Availability

The data generated during this study are available from the corresponding author on reasonable request.
